messages:
Nina (Design): Heads-up from usability: modal action alignment looks off on narrow viewports. primary and secondary buttons feel cramped against the footer edge when spacing token is at 12px. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ui/modal-footer-gap.png
Lee (Frontend): I can repro. The ghost button also has low contrast against secondary surfaces in dark themes. WCAG for icons is getting borderline.
Marcus (PM): Users prefer denser modals but accessibility can't be compromised. Can we keep a tighter layout but ensure ghost variant meets contrast and maintain 44x44 touch targets?
Ivy (Dev): Plan: keep spacing tokens unchanged (no renames) but add a theme alias for "compact.modalFooterGap" = 8px so we don't break other consumers. Also will add a ghost-contrast token to raise the ghost icon color in dark theme.
a11y-bot: Checklist: ghost variant icon contrast >= 3:1 on interactive surfaces, action buttons maintain 44x44 hit area, focus styles visible, aria-labels for icon-only buttons, avoid visual-only cues.
Nina (Design): For copy: the secondary ghost button currently says "Cancel" and sits flush; consider adding 6px horizontal gap between it and primary to reduce accidental taps. Keep visual density by reducing outer padding instead.
Lee (Frontend): Proposed CSS patch:
```
.modal-footer { padding: 10px 12px; gap: 6px }
.button-ghost { color: var(--ghost-contrast); }
@media (max-width: 560px) { .modal { padding-left: 12px; padding-right: 12px } }
```
I'll wire compact.modalFooterGap into theme override so consumers can opt-in.
Ivy (Dev): Also noted toast stacking issue: sticky table headers and modals with fixed footers push up toasts anchored top-right. Suggest using toast.offsetTop token and increasing by modal footer height when modal open OR anchor to top with offset token. Less risky than changing header z-index.
Marcus (PM): Sounds good. Target for this small UX fix in next patch (3.2.4). No token renames; token alias only. Include a short note in release changelog about compact alias.
Lee (Frontend): I'll open PR with the CSS, theme alias, unit tests and Percy screenshots. Adding a small story in the component explorer demonstrating compact modal and ghost contrast.
Nina (Design): I'll add updated specs to the design token doc and include the compact alias rationale + a visual diff. Also adding alt copy suggestions for icon-only ghost buttons (aria-labels).
a11y-bot: Add to PR description: include keyboard-only screenshots, screenreader text checks, contrast numbers, and hit-target measurements.
Ivy (Dev): Can someone pair on Percy diff review after CI? want to make sure table header heights and modal stacking didn't regress.
Marcus (PM): I'll block 20 minutes after CI for a quick review.
Nina (Design): Thanks team! small follow-up: revisit ghost variant naming later if we need more granularity, but not this release. :white_check_mark:
